name: Hu

attributes.attribute: a Neo-pagan god of agriculture, called Hu Gadarn or Hu the Mighty
worshiped by some Neo-pagan cults that claim to practice Druidry
dates to the Middle Ages, possibly a vestige of an earlier god

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Hu is a Neo-pagan god. He is also called Hu Gadarn, or Hu the Mighty. Some cults of contemporary Neo-pagans worship him. These cults claim to practice Druidry. Hu is an agricultural divinity. Most evidence dates him to the Middle Ages. He may be a vestige of an even earlier god. His oldest form is not certain. Hu stands for the force of the land and of growth. He links modern worship to the older Celtic past.

okr.objective: Document Hu, the Neo-pagan agricultural god called Hu Gadarn or Hu the Mighty.
key_results: Record the names Hu Gadarn and Hu the Mighty.
Note the Neo-pagan cults that worship him and practice Druidry.
Describe his likely Middle Ages origin and his possible older root.
